Installation

Requirements

  • Python >= 3.10

  • numpy >= 1.26.1

  • pandas >= 2.2.2

  • plotly >= 5.18.0

  • scikit-learn >= 1.5.1

  • python-dateutil >= 2.8.2

  • tqdm >= 4.66.5

  • prince >= 0.14.0

Install from PyPI

pip install dashi

Install from source

git clone https://github.com/bdslab-upv/dashi.git
cd dashi
pip install .
